download_vstar_benchmark: download the V-Star visual reasoning benchmark dataset from HuggingFace to a local directory
download_vstar_force: force re-download the V-Star benchmark dataset from HuggingFace even if it already exists
load_vstar_prompts: load all V-Star benchmark prompts into a dictionary keyed by prompt ID
review_download_function: review the download function that fetches V-Star test questions and images from HuggingFace
review_load_prompts_function: review the load_prompts function that reads prompts.jsonl and returns a lookup dictionary
